resources.string: As soon as you finish one on the watch, it appears here — with the route if the phone was with you. Without Kieselsport on the watch this screen stays empty; workouts from other apps appear as soon as they are in the health record.
No route — either the phone was not with you, or the location permission was missing.
Kieselsport recorded these routes, but Health Connect has no workout for them. Logging takes time and route from the GPS track and heart rate from Health Connect; calories and steps are missing.
None in the last seven days.
Only while in use — not enough

The watch has no GPS. During a workout the phone records the route — with a visible notification in the bar, and only between start and stop. Without the permission the workout is still logged, just without a map.

“Only while using the app” is not enough here. The workout starts on the watch while the phone is in your pocket and this app is closed — in that state Android allows no location, and the route would stay empty. “Allow all the time” is needed. Location is still only measured between start and stop of a workout.
